Hey, welcome in! 🐩

Every title on [animepoodle](https://animepoodle.mavern.in) has its own thread in this category. They're created automatically the first time someone comments on that title's page, so you don't need to open one yourself. Find the show, manga or manhwa on the site, scroll to **Comments**, and say hello.

### What these threads are for

- Telling people why you loved (or couldn't finish) something
- Recommending what to watch or read next if you liked this one
- Talking about the adaptation, the music, the art, that one episode
- Asking "is it worth getting past episode 3?" and getting honest answers

### A few ground rules

The full version lives at [animepoodle.mavern.in/rules](https://animepoodle.mavern.in/rules#community). The short version:

1. **Be kind.** Disagree about the story, not the person.
2. **Mark your spoilers.** Start with "Spoiler" and the episode or chapter, and tuck the details inside a `<details>` block:
   ```
   <details><summary>Spoiler (episode 12)</summary>
   The thing that happens.
   </details>
   ```
3. **Stay on topic.** One thread, one title.
4. **No piracy links.** Official platforms, publishers and news sites are welcome.
5. **No spam or self-promotion,** unless it's your own fan art or review and it adds something.
6. **Keep it safe for everyone.** No sexual content involving minors, no hate speech, no doxxing.

Comments that break these get hidden or removed, and repeat cases get blocked. If something needs a look, react with 👎 and open an issue linking to it.

### Good to know

- Anyone can **read** these threads without an account. To **post** or react, you sign in with GitHub inside the comment box. animepoodle never sees your password.
- Your comments are public on GitHub, and you can edit or delete them any time.
- Your library, ratings and taste settings on animepoodle are separate. They stay in your browser and never end up here.

Found a bug or have an idea for the site? Head to **Ideas & feedback** instead, so it doesn't get lost in a story thread.

Happy watching and reading. ✨
